data.body: Corrected root-cause after plan-review BLOCK (E4). Original premise (current _slim omits norm_id for DET findings) was refuted: sidecar.py:664 emits norm_id unconditionally via norm_id() which never returns None. Actual cause is schema-VINTAGE: commit 314e4191c826 (2026-06-29) added the norm_id field to _slim; REVIEW_RESULT events committed before it lack the key. Scan of _review_findings over the tracker: 1437/79914 findings lack norm_id, ALL with event-ts < 2026-06-29, ZERO after, spanning both tiers (LLM 1299, DET 138). Removed the incorrect bug 884d citation (884d is about the verification block, not norm_id). Fix (defensive .get + skip) unchanged.
